items.title: Jedediah Smith’s journal, first expedition to California, 7 August 1826 – 3 July 1827
items.author: Jedediah S. Smith
items.note: Smith’s own journal of the first California expedition, from the rendezvous at the bend of the Bear River. Transcribed text.

items.title: Jedediah Smith to William Clark, 12 July 1827
items.author: Jedediah S. Smith
items.note: Smith’s report to the Superintendent of Indian Affairs at St Louis, from the letterbook now held by the Kansas State Historical Society; reprinted in the Missouri Republican, 11 October 1827.

items.title: Jedediah Smith’s journal, second expedition to California, 13 July 1827 – 3 July 1828
items.author: Jedediah S. Smith
items.note: The journal of the expedition that entered Oregon. It breaks off on 3 July 1828, eleven days before the attack.

items.title: Journal of Harrison G. Rogers, 15 August 1826 – 27 January 1827
items.author: Harrison G. Rogers
items.note: The clerk’s first journal, opening with the inventory of trade goods taken for the southwest expedition.

items.title: The second journal of Harrison G. Rogers, 10 May – 13 July 1828
items.author: Harrison G. Rogers
items.note: The daily record of the last ten weeks, opening with the roll of the men with Smith and ending on 13 July 1828. Rogers was killed the next day.

items.title: John McLoughlin to the Honourable Committee, Hudson’s Bay Company, 10 August 1828
items.author: John McLoughlin
items.note: The letter written from Fort Vancouver two days after Arthur Black reached it. A scan of the manuscript; no searchable text.

items.title: Journal of Alexander Roderick McLeod, 6 September – 16 October 1828
items.author: Alexander Roderick McLeod
items.note: The Hudson’s Bay Company brigade leader’s journal of the expedition sent to recover the stolen property. A scan of the manuscript; no searchable text.

items.title: Journal of Alexander Roderick McLeod, 6 September – 10 December 1828
items.author: Alexander Roderick McLeod
items.note: The longer run of the same journal, carrying through the return along the coast. A scan of the manuscript; no searchable text.

items.title: Smith, Jackson & Sublette to the Secretary of War, 29 October 1830
items.author: Jedediah S. Smith, David E. Jackson and William L. Sublette
items.note: The partners’ report to Secretary of War John H. Eaton. A scan; no searchable text.

items.title: Lancaster Pollard’s 1944 edition of the Harvey Gordon survey account, with later matter
items.author: Lancaster Pollard (ed.), and others
items.note: Pollard’s note on the 1857–58 General Land Office survey, first published in the Oregon Historical Quarterly for June 1944, gathered here with later material. Identified by reference; its subject is the location of the site.

items.title: The Ashley-Smith Explorations and the Discovery of a Central Route to the Pacific, 1822–1829
items.author: Harrison Clifford Dale
items.note: The 1918 edition of the journals and correspondence that first put this record into print. The creator’s index calls it “Dale’s 1918 classic book.” 52.5 MB — linked, not copied.

items.title: Peter Skene Ogden’s Snake Country Journal 1826–27
items.author: K. G. Davies (ed.), assisted by A. M. Johnson, with an introduction by Dorothy O. Johansen
items.note: The Hudson’s Bay Record Society edition, London, 1961. Third-party work; identified by reference.

items.title: Brush Fences and Basket Traps: The Archaeology and Ethnohistory of Tidewater Weir Fishing on the Oregon Coast
items.author: R. Scott Byram
items.note: Doctoral dissertation, University of California, Berkeley, 2002. Third-party work; identified by reference.

items.title: Byram, 20 September 2008
items.author: R. Scott Byram
items.note: A second Byram item in the creator’s reference folder. No text layer; not examined further. Third-party work; identified by reference.

items.title: Archaeology, Ethnography, and Tolowa Heritage at Red Elderberry Place, Chvn-su’lh-dvn, Jedediah Smith Redwoods State Park
items.author: Shannon Tushingham
items.note: California Department of Parks and Recreation, Publications in Cultural Heritage No. 30, 2013. Third-party work; identified by reference. The Library does not reproduce its site content.

items.title: The Working Man’s Rendezvous
items.author: Tameron Gentry Raines Williams
items.note: Thesis, Utah State University, August 2022. Third-party work; identified by reference.

items.title: The Legend of Jedediah Smith: Fact, Fantasy and Opinion
items.author: James C. Auld
items.note: Published in the Jedediah Smith Society’s journal, 2008. Third-party work; identified by reference.

items.title: Auld, 2014
items.author: James C. Auld
items.note: The creator’s guidebooks cite an Auld article, “Jedediah Smith’s Disaster at Defeat River,” in the 2014 Rocky Mountain Fur Trade Journal. No text layer on this copy. Third-party work; identified by reference.

items.title: Tracking Jedediah Smith through Hupa Territory
items.author: Lee Davis
items.note: American Indian Quarterly 13:4 (Autumn 1989), 369–389. Third-party work; identified by reference.

items.title: Smithsonian Miscellaneous Collections, vol. 97, no. 8
items.author: David I. Bushnell, Jr.
items.note: A 1938 Smithsonian paper reproducing Seth Eastman’s drawings from George Gibbs’s 1851 sketches, including the Tish-rawa village on the Klamath. A United States government publication.

items.title: Earliest Expedition against Puget Sound Indians
items.author: Eva Emery Dye and Frank Ermatinger
items.note: Washington Historical Quarterly 1:2 (January 1907), 16–29. Published before 1929.

items.title: Old Fort Vancouver, 1824–1829
items.author: John A. Hussey
items.note: Excerpted by the National Park Service from Hussey’s history of Fort Vancouver. A United States government publication.

items.title: Bibliography of the Siuslaw and Kuitsh Indians: An Indigenous People of the Central Oregon Coast
items.author: Don Macnaughtan
items.note: Ethnographic Bibliographies no. 1, 2002. Third-party work; identified by reference.

items.title: Nasomah Massacre of 1854
items.author: Jason Younker (Coquille Nation)
items.note: An encyclopedia article on the 1854 killings at the mouth of the Coquille River. Third-party work; identified by reference.

items.title: Oregon–to–California Trail (1820s–1860s)
items.author: Jeff LaLande
items.note: An encyclopedia article on the overland route between the two states. Third-party work; identified by reference.

items.title: The Really Big One
items.author: Kathryn Schulz
items.note: The New Yorker, 20 July 2015, on the Cascadia subduction zone. The creator keeps it because the 1700 earthquake shaped the coast the party had to cross. Third-party work; identified by reference.

items.title: La Question de l’Oregon, in the Cowlitz Historical Quarterly, Winter 2021
items.author: Robert Foxcurran and John C. Jackson
items.note: Cowlitz Historical Quarterly 63:4. Third-party work; identified by reference.

items.title: Cowlitz Historical Quarterly, September 2019
items.author: Charles Hubbs and Robert Foxcurran
items.note: Cowlitz Historical Quarterly 61:3. Third-party work; identified by reference.

items.title: The Distany of the Golden Dragoon — draft
items.author: John C. Jackson
items.note: An unpublished 1983 typescript, marked “First Serial Rights, Copyright 1983.” Third-party work; identified by reference, and not reproduced.

items.title: Swagerty, 1988
items.author: W. R. Swagerty
items.note: A four-page item in the reference folder; no text layer. Third-party work; identified by reference.

items.title: Castor Canadensis, newsletter of the Jedediah Smith Society, Fall 2014
items.author: Jedediah Smith Society
items.note: Reprints Lancaster Pollard’s 1944 Oregon Historical Quarterly note, by permission of the Quarterly. Third-party work; identified by reference. Its subject is the location of the site.

items.title: Castor Canadensis, the Journal of the Jedediah Smith Society, vol. 2 no. 1, Spring 2023
items.author: Jedediah Smith Society
items.note: The whole Spring 2023 issue, whose lead article is the creator’s account of the Rendezvous. The article itself is published here page by page; the rest of the issue is other people’s work, identified by reference.

items.title: “Jedediah Smith,” a drawing, 1990
items.author: José Cisneros
items.note: Commissioned by the Jedediah Smith Society and used as the frontispiece of the 2023 guidebooks. Third-party work by a named artist; identified by reference.

items.title: Crooks, undated
items.author: Crooks
items.note: A thirty-page item in the reference folder; no text layer. Third-party work; identified by reference.

items.title: Crooks–Crookston, 1916–2003
items.author: Crooks and Crookston
items.note: A twenty-nine-page item in the reference folder; no text layer. Third-party work; identified by reference.

items.title: Newspaper articles on the 1860 Indian Island killings
items.author: Bret Harte and others, gathered by the Northwestern California Genocide Project
items.note: A modern web compilation of 1860 newspaper reports. The nineteenth-century texts are long out of copyright; the compilation is a third-party work, identified by reference.

items.title: Newspaper clippings and project papers, 2000–2014
items.author: Wayne Knauf and others
items.note: The file the memorial project grew out of, beginning with The Reedsport Courier of July 2000. Third-party newspaper material; identified by reference.

items.title: Whereat and Knauf, 7 February 2001 — field map
items.author: Don Whereat and Wayne Knauf
items.note: The creator’s index describes this as “Whereat’s 2001 map.” Don Whereat was the Quuiich tribal historian. Third-party work; identified by reference. Not displayed: it is a site map.

items.title: Whereat and others, 7 November 2006
items.author: Don Whereat and others
items.note: An eight-page item; no text layer. Third-party work; identified by reference.

items.title: The World (Coos Bay), 31 October 2023 — front-page report on the dedication
items.author: David Rupkalvis
items.note: Third-party newspaper work; identified by reference.

items.title: The Oregonian / OregonLive, 26–27 October 2023 — report on the memorial
items.author: Lori Tobias
items.note: Third-party newspaper work; identified by reference.
